issues.description: LoginJali is displayed at w-20 (80px) from a 480-unit viewBox, so the stroke-width-4 lattice renders at ~0.67 CSS px and the interstitial diamonds at ~5px; on standard-DPI screens the emblem anti-aliases to a pale gray mark instead of a crisp carved-ink jali, weakening the one bespoke art moment on the page.
issues.resolution: Fixed with both halves of the hint combined (either alone stays sub-pixel or lands exactly at 1px with muddier negative space): rendered size raised w-20 -> w-24 (96px, scale 0.2) with mb-8 -> mb-10 rebalance in login.astro, and SVG weights raised in LoginJali.astro — lattice/diamonds/medallion strokes 4 -> 5.5, carved frame 6 -> 8, center dot r 6 -> 8 (keeps the fill proportional). Strokes now render at ~1.1 CSS px (lattice) and ~1.6 CSS px (frame), preserving the ~1.45x frame-to-lattice hierarchy, the exact composition, and currentColor-only palette. A comment in the SVG records the tuned weights so they are not thinned later.
